description: Staging platform decisions (AUT-102 to AUT-111), planned by infra/terraform/envs/staging-core. Changed only through a reviewed pull request. An entry whose status is PROPOSED has not been decided by the owner: plans run with the proposed value, and stack.sh apply refuses while any PROPOSED entry remains. Secrets and personal addresses are never stored here.

kms.decision: Integrated workstream 2026-10-05: two customer-managed keys (data, audit) instead of three, for cost (cost report); yearly rotation; 30-day deletion window.

storage.decision: Proposed 2026-10-05 for owner decision D6 and the retention periods. Lifecycle values are reversible; Object Lock retention is not.

anchor_retention.decision: D6. The application locks every anchor in COMPLIANCE mode for 3650 days (api/veda/platform/anchor_store.py RETENTION). In staging that keeps each anchor, and the bucket, for ten years: nobody can delete them, the root user included. Options: (a) accept 10 years in staging; (b) a reviewed application change making the retention configurable, then a short staging value. The bucket has Object Lock enabled with no default retention either way.

cloudtrail.decision: Proposed 2026-10-05: one multi-region trail of management events, log-file validation, audit key, copy in CloudWatch Logs kept 30 days (the S3 copy follows storage.logs_cloudtrail_expire_days). veda-boundary denies every role cloudtrail:Put*Selectors and UpdateTrail, so the S3 data events on the anchor and evidence buckets (FC-01, RR-09 attribution) are added once by the owner session after the first apply (runbook).

ecr.decision: Proposed 2026-10-05: one repository veda-api (the bootstrap deploy role pushes only there), immutable tags, basic scan on push, data key; keep the last 30 tagged images, expire untagged images after 7 days. Litestream and cloudflared keep coming from Docker Hub, pinned by digest (the deploy role cannot push other repositories).

ssm.decision: Proposed 2026-10-05: D7 staging host names; the trusted proxy is cloudflared on the host network (loopback); Litestream keeps 7 days of WAL; session transcripts 90 days; sessions end after 20 idle minutes and 60 minutes in all. Secrets are seeded by the owner under /veda/staging/app (AUT-302).

monitoring.decision: Proposed 2026-10-05: application and host logs kept 30 days; a fixed set of 7 log metric filters instead of EMF (cost); alarm thresholds below; alarms email the owner (BUDGET_ALERT_EMAIL secret) and feed the drill queue.

compute.decision: Proposed 2026-10-05: t4g.small (N2, decided) with burst credits capped (standard); 12 GB root and 20 GB data volumes (gp3, data key); 7 daily snapshots of the data volume; the AMI is the latest Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 at the first plan and is then pinned here (ami_id).

ses.decision: Proposed 2026-10-05: sender no-reply@staging.vedaspaces.com (a subdomain, so the apex records never change; DKIM CNAMEs published by AUT-202); sandbox, with the owner's address verified as recipient (more rehearsal recipients: O11); alarm when the bounce rate exceeds 5 %.
